# Cardboard Bale Recycling

> Cardboard Bale Recycling is a referral service. Businesses in the United States request cardboard bale pickup, quotes for selling baled cardboard, loose cardboard pickup and baler or compactor rental. Requests go to partner recyclers and suppliers in our network, which prepare the quotes and set prices, schedules and terms. Pricing is by quote; availability depends on partner suppliers near the business.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://cardboardbalerecycling.com/): what you can request and how it works
- [Services](https://cardboardbalerecycling.com/services): bale pickup, bale sales, loose cardboard pickup, baler rental
- [How It Works](https://cardboardbalerecycling.com/how-it-works): from a request to a partner supplier's quote
- [Pricing](https://cardboardbalerecycling.com/pricing): what affects cardboard bale pricing; pricing is by quote
- [Resources](https://cardboardbalerecycling.com/resources): cardboard grades, bale preparation, balers and compactors
- [Service Areas](https://cardboardbalerecycling.com/service-areas): state and city directory
- [Get a Quote](https://cardboardbalerecycling.com/quote): free, no-obligation request form
